verdict.rationale: Hightouch's own SQL/dbt models let data engineers transform, filter, and enrich data with custom SQL before syncs map rows to destinations (docs-2, docs-23, docs-27, comm-2). Event data, however, lands in the warehouse first, with the logic living there (docs-5, docs-17), so this is warehouse-side modeling rather than in-pipeline event transformation. missing for 10: documented in-stream event transformation functions, custom-code (e.g. JavaScript) transforms on events before delivery, in-pipeline event filtering/enrichment, independent hands-on corroboration.
